items.en: Ukraine's 3rd Army Corps reports first drone strike on Russia's new TOS-3 Drakon thermobaric launcher
items.nl: Oekraïens 3e Legerkorps meldt eerste dronetreffer op nieuwe Russische TOS-3 Drakon thermobarische raketwerper
items.sEn: Ukraine's 3rd Army Corps says it has struck a Russian TOS-3 Drakon ("Dragon") thermobaric rocket launcher for the first time, and has published video of the attack, Ukrainska Pravda reports citing the corps' social media. The system was hit by a drone flown by the Muramasa unit of the Kraken Separate Unmanned Systems…
